units.source_text: 六月中有一日，天气炎热，源氏在六条院东边的钓殿中纳凉。

en.t: One day in the middle of the sixth month, the weather was very hot, and Genji was cooling himself in the fishing pavilion on the east side of Rokujo-in.
Lieutenant General Yugiri was attending at his side.

units.source_text: 许多亲信的殿上人在一旁侍候，当场调制桂川进呈的鲇鱼和贺茂川产的鰌鱼。

en.t: Many trusted courtiers waited nearby, preparing on the spot the sweetfish presented from the Katsura River and the loaches from the Kamo River.

units.source_text: 内大臣家那几位公子前来访问夕雾。

en.t: Several young gentlemen from the Minister of the Center's household came to visit Yugiri.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“寂寞得很，想打瞌睡，你们来得正好。”

en.t: Genji said, "I was terribly bored and beginning to doze off; you have come at just the right time."

units.source_text: 便请他们喝酒，饮冰水，吃凉水泡饭，座上非常热闹。

en.t: He then invited them to drink wine, sip ice water, and eat rice soaked in cool water, and the gathering became very lively.

units.source_text: 凉风吹来，颇觉快适；但天空赤日炎炎，了无纤云。

en.t: A cool breeze blew in and felt quite pleasant, but the red sun blazed in the sky without so much as a wisp of cloud.

units.source_text: 夕阳西倾之时，蝉声聒耳，不胜苦热之感。

en.t: When the evening sun began to slope westward, the clamor of cicadas filled their ears, making the oppressive heat almost unbearable.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“这种暑天，在水上也没有用。

en.t: Genji said, "On a hot day like this, even being over the water is no help.

units.source_text: 又说：“这种时候，玩管弦也没兴味。

en.t: He added, "At a time like this, even playing flutes and strings has no charm.
And yet the day is long, there is nothing to do, and it is very tedious.

units.source_text: 在宫中供职的那些年轻人，带也不解，纽也不松，真有些儿难当呢。

en.t: Those young men serving at court cannot loosen their sashes or even their cords; it must truly be hard to bear.

units.source_text: 我们在这里无拘无束，好不自在，你们且把最近的世事和使人醒睡的奇闻讲些给我听听吧。

en.t: Here we are free and easy, quite at leisure, so tell me some recent news of the world and a few strange tales lively enough to wake a man from sleep.

units.source_text: 我已不知不觉地变成了一个老翁，世事全然不懂了。”

en.t: Before I knew it, I had become an old man and no longer understand the world at all."

units.source_text: 但那些年轻人一时也想不出新奇的事件来，大家毕恭毕敬地把背靠在凉爽的栏杆上，默默不语。

en.t: But the young men could not think of any novel events at once, and they all respectfully leaned their backs against the cool railing and sat in silence.
